title: You, Like a Patch of Sunlight

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought she was like
a warm patch of sunlight... I really did.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Around lunchtime. Heading over to the academy's
outdoor stage to eat lunch, I heard—

Ah...! E-Excuse me! Is that...
a "Farm-Fresh Triple Milk Donut"...?!
choice_data_list: Huh? Ah, yeah.

text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! Um, where did you buy it?
I've been looking everywhere, but the school store was all sold out...!
choice_data_list: I can tell you where I got it, if you'd like.

text_block_list.text: Really?! Oh, thank you so much! ...Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. I'm sorry for blurting that out all of a sudden.
My name is Dantsu Flame.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...From that tiny, trivial encounter,
Dantsu Flame and I started exchanging words—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
♪~ ♪~
—Oh, hello, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Good morning. You seem in high spirits today.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: The truth is... I got a perfect score on our pop quiz today!
choice_data_list: Whoa, that's awesome!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I totally surprised myself—
...Are you heading out somewhere after this, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, heading to the racetrack for some training seminars.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see!
Thank you for all your hard work. Good luck out there!
choice_data_list: Thanks. Good luck with your afternoon classes too, Dantsu.
Thanks. Good luck with your afternoon classes too, Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the days passed, we began greeting and chatting
with each other whenever we crossed paths—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Until one day. While watching the academy track
and pondering modern training theory—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hmm, something still feels off... What should I do...?
—Huh? Trainer?
choice_data_list: Hey, fancy meeting you here. Doing some self-practice?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. ...Actually, I got selected to run in a Mock Race,
so I've been doing some tune-ups for it.
choice_data_list: Oh...! That's great! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you.
...But I just haven't been feeling it today, and I'm kind of stuck.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um, only if you have the time, of course...
Would you mind taking a look at my running...?
choice_data_list: If you're okay with me, I'd love to!
If you're okay with me, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...! Really?! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ————Haah... haah... haah...!
choice_data_list: Alright, spurt through to the goal!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! —Yaaah!!
choice_data_list: (I see...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame's running showed hesitation during acceleration.
Honestly, at this stage, she didn't show standout natural talent. However—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —Haah... haah... H-How... was that?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think you can grow a lot more before the actual race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was real drive burning in her eyes. Plus, she possessed the ambition
and flexibility to seek outside advice to improve. The foundation for growth was undeniably there...!
choice_data_list: If it's alright with you, let me lend a hand.
If it's alright with you, let me lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? A-Are you sure...?! But Trainer,
you're still looking for a horsegirl to train—
choice_data_list: I figured meeting like this was fate... What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'd love that!
I'm in your care...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, until the day of the Mock Race,
my days supervising Dantsu Flame's training began—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Phew...—
One last set...!
choice_data_list: Your form is looking better. Keep that momentum going.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? Yay...! I'll focus
on keeping it clean for this final set too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah... haah...!
choice_data_list: Good, hold that exact pace for one more furlong!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Keep the rhythm... don't let the core wobble...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dantsu Flame diligently tackled the training regimen I set every day,
improving her stride bit by bit, but steadily nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her earnest dedication day in and day out,
a certain conviction began welling up inside me as a Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And finally, the day of the Mock Race arrived.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
400 meters remaining! Now comes the critical moment!
Who will make the decisive move?!
choice_data_list: (The timing is good...! Go, Dantsu!)
(The timing is good...! Go, Dantsu!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Number 7 surges forward with a blistering burst of speed! Incredible pace!
The pack chases close behind! Can anyone catch her?!
choice_data_list: Go for it, Dantsu!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She holds her ground! Crossing the line!!
The winner of today's Mock Race is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dantsu Flame couldn't quite catch Number 7 who had made the early break,
finishing in a heartbreaking second place. Yet, from where I stood—
choice_data_list: (Everything we worked on showed on the track. More than enough!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She can run. She's a horsegirl who turns hard work into real results.
Even if she didn't win today, I want to support her growth...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Um, I...
choice_data_list: If you'll have me, I want to scout you...!
If you'll have me, I want to scout you...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Eh—... What?! B-But I just lost, you know...?! So why scout me...?!
choice_data_list: Because I want to stand behind your earnest spirit.
Because I want to stand behind your earnest spirit.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: I'm still a rookie trainer, but I'll give it everything I've got. So—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—I-I accept! Your scouting offer!
I want to sign a contract with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so happy, truly. Because... I never thought anyone
would ask me after losing like that...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um. I'm nowhere near ready to take center stage just yet...
Even so... please take care of me from now on!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Right back at you, Dantsu!
Yeah! Right back at you, Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in her sunlight-like smile,
our days of tackling new challenges together began... Or so I thought—
